_doc: Block-hash allowlist for tn-claim-guard.py 'prohibited_public_positioning' rules. Entries only allow specific known-good contexts; the guard identifies them by SHA-256 of the enclosing HTML block, not by line number, so any edit to a whitelisted block silently invalidates the exemption and re-fails the guard. Regex C is now noun-agnostic (installer/dealer/distributor/partner/reseller/fabricator, bare 'Authorized' labels, 'manufacturer-authorized'), and editorial third-party phrasing is separated structurally (a first-party ACG subject is required) rather than by entry, so only one narrow class is listed here: architect spec-section and blog checklist text that states what a SPEC should require of the installer, which is not an ACG self-claim. The former class (2) - the byte-frozen West Palm Beach pages, whose copy could not be edited while .github/seo/url-primaries.json frozen_prefixes was in force - is gone as of 2026-08-28: the owner lifted the freeze on /eswindows-installer-west-palm-beach.html, /storefront-glazier-west-palm-beach-florida/ and /storefront-installer-west-palm-beach.html, all 28 authorization claims were rewritten as capability language, and the 13 block hashes that exempted them were deleted with the copy. Do not add a class-(2) style entry again: a frozen page is a reason to schedule the copy fix, not to exempt the claim.
